spellbook.finance/limitations: Facts only. No store ranking, split calculation, purchase recommendation, checkout or purchase is performed.
Offers preserve native currency and exact product identity. Shipping, tax, stock and destination eligibility can remain unknown; item subtotal is not landed cost.
List reads contain at most 100 lines; offer reads contain at most 10 lines and 80 offers per product. Follow nextCursor; completeList describes saved-list traversal, never complete merchant coverage.

description: Save destination, market and currency context and return a list header. Call after reading spellbook_sealed_shopping_list; null clears a field and omission preserves it. Call spellbook_sealed_shopping_offers next; destination context does not prove shipping eligibility.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

currency.description: ISO currency context; null clears, omission preserves. No conversion is performed.

anyOf.description: Destination ISO country code; shipping eligibility can remain unknown.

destinationCountry.description: Destination country; null clears, omission preserves.

anyOf.description: Retailer market to observe; this does not establish delivery eligibility.

retailerMarketRegion.description: Retailer market; null clears, omission preserves.

name: spellbook_sealed_shopping_list_context
